race.comment: GRANDAD'S ADICTION (8) just missed two back when 2L off the winner before a 3.2L defeat last time out when back in trip on the quick turnaround. He's racing well without winning and CJP remains on board with things looking to shape nicely for him. Can feature in the finish. GINGER AND TONIC (6) steps out to 1700m again after closing strongly over 1400m recently. Out in trip is no issue now and if she runs to recent form, she won't be far away. JESA LUPA (3) has been rather plain to begin this campaign, but he looks ready to improve now out in distance. Parnham replaces the apprentice hoop and the rise in trip looks suitable. Can run a much better race today. GASPARDO (10) is third-up now and was only 1L away last time out. Keep safe. POINT GIBRALTAR (1) is next best.
